acceptance.output_evidence:
OGZ3-AC3: control: a granted account resolves (revision 1); outside the set, 3 of 3 probes -> ENTITLEMENT_DENIED with 1 distinct denial body ({"code": "entitlement_denied", "error": "1 of 1 account reference(s) are not in the principal's current authorized account set for master 08242234", "error_code": "ENTITLEMENT_DENIED", "guard_denied": true}): an account granted to another principal, an account in no grant anywhere, a random well-formed reference; reads during the 3 probes 6, all strong get_item on the principal's own POLICY partition, other partitions 0, query/scan 0; the other principal resolves its own account (the account exists); after grant revision 2 drops one account's slot: the dropped account -> the same denial body, the kept account resolves at revision 2; after revocation -> ENTITLEMENT_DENIED (the principal holds no active data entitlement); raw account ids in the 5 denial bodies 0
1 passed in 0.92s
rc=0
acceptance.denominator: 3 probes spanning the existence axis: an account that EXISTS in another principal's grant, an account in NO grant anywhere, and a random well-formed reference. All 3 return ENTITLEMENT_DENIED, and their denial bodies are 1 distinct value, so nothing in the answer separates an existing account from one that does not exist. The resolver consults no account inventory: the 6 reads during those probes are all strong get_item on the principal's OWN POLICY partition, 0 on any other partition, 0 query and 0 scan. CURRENT means current: after grant revision 2 drops one account, its reference returns that same denial body while the kept account resolves at revision 2, and after revocation the kept reference is denied too. Positive control: the other principal resolves the very account whose reference was denied to the first, so the denial was the grant's doing and not the account's. Raw account ids across the 5 denial bodies: 0. 1 of 1 test, verbatim at 1006e6a702.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: `OGZ3-AC5` (`test_ogz3_ac05`) -- a reference under a retired key version is handled by the stated rule. <invocation>cd <WS> && timeout 120 .venv-og/Scripts/python -m pytest infra/aws/ec2/opal-gateway/tests/test_account_ref.py::test_ogz3_ac05 -q -p no:cacheprovider --color=no</invocation><expect>(?m)^1 passed(?![^\n]*(failed|error))</expect>
acceptance.output_evidence:
OGZ3-AC5: rule REJECT -- a reference whose version is not the current one -> EXPIRED_REFERENCE, decided on the version token alone; before rotation the v1 reference resolves; rotated to v2 (the v1 key left in the secret), the secret re-read 1 time(s): 5 of 5 probes -> EXPIRED_REFERENCE with 1 distinct denial body (1 of 1 account reference(s) were issued under a retired key version; obtain current references again): v1 reference of a granted account, v1 reference of another principal's account, v1 reference of an account in no grant, random v1 reference, v3 reference (never issued); the same account under v2 -> a new reference acr_v2_ (equal to an independent recomputation), resolved; a request mixing a v2 and a v1 reference -> EXPIRED_REFERENCE, 0 accounts; order: the entitlement is checked first, so a revoked principal's v1 reference -> ENTITLEMENT_DENIED
1 passed in 0.97s
rc=0
acceptance.denominator: THE STATED RULE, declared in app/account_ref.py's module docstring and in the result file: REJECT -- only the current key version is minted or resolved, and a well-formed reference under any other version is refused with EXPIRED_REFERENCE, read from the version token alone before any key or account is consulted. Before rotation the v1 reference resolves (control). After rotating to v2, with the retired v1 key deliberately LEFT in the secret, 5 of 5 probes are EXPIRED_REFERENCE with 1 distinct denial body: a v1 reference of a granted account, of another principal's account, of an account in no grant, a random v1 reference, and a v3 reference that was never issued -- so the answer cannot distinguish them and the retired key is never used. The same account re-minted under v2 differs from its v1 reference, equals an independent recomputation under the v2 key, and resolves. A request mixing a v2 and a v1 reference is EXPIRED_REFERENCE with 0 accounts. The rotation cost exactly 1 further GetSecretValue. Order: the entitlement is read first, so a revoked principal's v1 reference is ENTITLEMENT_DENIED, not EXPIRED_REFERENCE. 1 of 1 test, verbatim at 1006e6a702.

mutant.description: Five in-process mutants through a pytest plugin (.scratch/og_z3_mutants.py, loaded with -p og_z3_mutants and PYTHONPATH=.scratch; the committed bytes untouched), each run against the criteria it must break. unkeyed: _mac drops the key for a plain digest (AC1). no_master: _mac drops the master from the message (AC2). resolve_any: the module's hmac.compare_digest always returns True, so every reference matches the authorized set (AC2, AC3). accept_retired: the reference regex reports every reference as carrying the CURRENT version, removing the retired-key rule (AC5). log_raw: resolve_refs logs the resolved raw ids (AC4).
mutant.expected: unkeyed: 1 failed. no_master: 1 failed. resolve_any: 2 failed. accept_retired: 1 failed. log_raw: 1 failed.
mutant.observed: unkeyed: 'MUTANT unkeyed' | AC1 'AssertionError: (6, 0)' -- shape still 6 of 6, the independent keyed recomputation 0 of 6 | '1 failed in 1.19s', rc=1. no_master: 'MUTANT no_master' | AC2 'AssertionError: (0, 200)' -- 0 of 200 pairs differ across the masters | '1 failed in 1.22s', rc=1. resolve_any: 'MUTANT resolve_any' | AC2 "AssertionError: ('08242234', Resolution(ok=True, ...))" on the cross-master reference | AC3 "assert (True and ('70412359',) == ('70412358',)" | '2 failed in 1.14s', rc=1. accept_retired: 'MUTANT accept_retired' | AC5 'assert False' (the retired reference answers ENTITLEMENT_DENIED, not EXPIRED_REFERENCE) | '1 failed in 1.03s', rc=1. log_raw: 'MUTANT log_raw' | AC4 "AssertionError: {('log records', '70412358'): 4, ('log records', '70412359'): 4, ('log records', '70412361'): 2}" -- the scanner finds the raw ids | '1 failed in 1.07s', rc=1.
